name: mutfakon-printer-agent
description: Local helper on the kasa: lists printers and prints receipts without a dialog.

scripts.build:win: npm run bundle && pkg dist/agent.cjs --targets node22-win-x64 --output dist/mutfakon-printer-agent.exe
scripts.build:win-go: cd go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -ldflags "-s -w -H=windowsgui" -o ../dist/mutfakon-printer-agent-go.exe .
